Readers · book clubs · in French

Reading tracker

For readers who set themselves a yearly goal. Your library in print, e-book and audio (audiobooks counted in hours), to read, reading, read or abandoned. Log a session in two seconds (the page you reached, or minutes listened): progress, your current pace and the date you will finish the book are calculated. Your yearly goal in books and pages shows how many days ahead or behind you are, with the pace needed to finish on time. Statistics by month, genre and author, reading streaks, ratings, notes and quotes, a prioritised to-read list. Nothing is looked up online, no public profile.
